bio: Ray is a long-time cinephile and aspiring screenwriter. When he's not working his day job doing psychological research, he's likely running statistics on box office and/or awards prognostication, making minor headway on scripts he's never quite satisfied with, or actually watching movies. He's been a passionate member of the Filmball community since 2025, and is always excited to help nurture the community in any way he can (or simply just spread his oft-controversial film opinions). Follow him on Awards Expert: banjosudswater
name: Ray Siddiqi
